name: Cajun Spiced Ribeye with Green Bean, Tomato & Basil Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg green beans
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap).
Bring green beans to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 2-3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then set aside to drain further.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; sprinkle Cajun seasoning and salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, peel and mince shallot. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with the cooked green beans, and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!
